metadata.title: Mid-Century Rock and Roll Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century portrait layout featuring a smiling subject against a dense, multicolored bokeh background with heavy, outlined slab-serif typography.
excludeWhen: high-contrast black and white photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a smiling man holding a guitar, positioned on the right third of the frame, set against a vibrant, out-of-focus background of red, blue, and white light circles. Bold, italicized slab-serif text is layered over the left and center of the image.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-aligned looking toward the left
Typography overlapping the blurred background on the left
High-key lighting on the subject contrasting with the saturated background
Diagonal guitar neck leading the eye from bottom left to center
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all display text
Italicized slab-serif font with high horizontal weight

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right 40% of the frame, scaled from waist to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, moves down the guitar strap to the hands, then across the bold text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the frame is filled with bokeh, providing a textured canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream and white (subject's clothing and text fill)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red, blue, and gold (bokeh lights and guitar details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background bokeh with high value/brightness on the subject and text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with an italic slant
letterConstructionRules: Strong italic lean to the right
characterSpecificRedesigns: Open counters in 'A' and 'R' to maintain legibility despite heavy weight
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family dominance with varying scale for secondary metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure and vintage feel.
Provides the geometric slab-serif look common in mid-century print.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a smiling man in a 1950s cardigan holding a guitar, positioned on the right side of the frame. The background should be a dense, vibrant field of red, blue, and white bokeh light circles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, uppercase, italicized slab-serif text on the left side. The text should have a cream fill and a thick black outline.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a thick black outline?
Is the background composed of multicolored bokeh?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of a thick black outline on text
Ensure the background is out-of-focus light circles
Confirm the subject is holding a musical instrument
Check that the text is left-aligned and italicized
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Portrait + Multicolored Bokeh + Outlined Slab Serif Typography
